title: Randomized Max-Vertex-Coverage Interdiction under Matroid Constraints
summary: We study a class of bilevel interdiction problems in which the follower's optimization problem is computationally intractable. Motivated by network defense applications, we introduce the Randomized Max-Vertex-Coverage Interdiction (RMVCI) problem under matroid constraints. In this zero-sum Stackelberg game, the leader commits to a randomized interdiction strategy over feasible vertex subsets, while the follower, after observing the induced protection probabilities, chooses a matroid-constrained attack to maximize the expected coverage of network edges.
